title: Attack on Titan: A Final-Season Reading Guide
description: A guide to the conflict, sacrifices, and world-changing stakes that define Attack on Titan's final story.
body: Attack on Titan follows a society living behind enormous walls while the threat of the Titans shapes every decision.
This reading guide focuses on the final season's escalating conflict and the questions it raises about freedom, loyalty, and survival.

title: Blue Lock: Striker Spotlight
description: Blue Lock turns Japan's search for an elite striker into a ruthless competition built on ego, instinct, and goals.
body: Blue Lock gathers ambitious forwards in a high-pressure training program designed to create one unmatched striker.
Its tension comes from players balancing collaboration with the individual hunger to score.
